label: Blind sample null 087: intact forest, no Hansen loss 2001-2023, tile 00N_110E

verdict.headline: Can't tell
verdict.statement: Greenness (NDVI) rose by 0.01 relative to the control trajectory in the 18 months after 1 Jan 2019 (90% interval −0.01 to +0.07). The same test was run on 60 untouched control cells. In 22 of them the no-event prediction missed by as much after the event date, relative to how closely it matched before, as it did here (placebo p = 0.38). Counted by gap size instead, 20 of the 60 moved at least as far as this area did in the same direction (p = 0.34). But: only 8 clear observation periods before the event (need 20).
reasons: only 8 clear observation periods before the event (need 20)

evidence.sentence: Neither optical nor radar shows a change beyond what the controls did.
